verdict.rationale: treg is a gateway that proxies agent tool calls, so an audit log of calls is a fair axis to judge. The evidence never documents a viewable call log or audit trail with request or response detail for replay. The only nearby items are per-call IDs used for rating calls and a `balance` command that reports daily usage, and both are adjacent features, not an audit log.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
